name: approval-reject-route
description: The ticket 15.3 reject-routing demonstration: a `human_approval` gate with `on_reject: route`. A rejected decision does not fail the run — the gate *succeeds* with `decision: reject` and fires only its `decision: reject` edge (to `notify_rejected`), while the unmarked approve edge (to `publish`) is skipped by ordinary skip propagation (ADR-017). An approve decision fires the approve edge and skips the reject edge instead. Either way the run completes; the author's choice of a dedicated reject branch versus a fail branch (`on_reject: fail`, the default in approval_gate.json) is a graph-shape decision the `decision` edge marker makes explicit and UI-renderable.

config.title: Publish or send back?
config.description: Approve to publish, reject to route the draft back for revision.
